figs.name: reynolds-number-flow-meter-selection-flowchart
figs.alt: flowchart to calculate reynolds number and select a flow meter by flow regime
figs.caption: Diagram by Instrumentation Blog showing how to calculate Re from density, velocity, bore and viscosity, then pick a flow meter by laminar, transitional or turbulent regime.
figs.after_h2: Reynolds Number and Flow Meter Selection: Which Meter for Which Re?

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 600" width="100%" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif">
<title>Flowchart to calculate Reynolds number and choose a flow meter</title>
<rect width="800" height="600" fill="#ffffff"/>
<defs><marker id="ah" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0 0L10 5L0 10z" fill="#1a2b4a"/></marker></defs>
<text x="400.0" y="34" font-size="24" fill="#075985" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">From Reynolds Number to Flow Meter Choice</text>
<rect x="200" y="56" width="400" height="62" rx="10" fill="#f0f9ff" stroke="#0284c7" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="400.0" y="81.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Collect ρ, v, D and μ</text>
<text x="400.0" y="104.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">use actual bore, not nominal size</text>
<line x1="400" y1="118" x2="400" y2="136" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="250" y="136" width="300" height="48" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#0284c7" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="400.0" y="166.65" font-size="19" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Re = ρ × v × D ÷ μ</text>
<line x1="400" y1="184" x2="400" y2="200" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<polygon points="400,201.0 520.0,246 400,291.0 280.0,246" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#0284c7" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="400" y="252.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Re < 2300?</text>
<line x1="280" y1="246" x2="236" y2="246" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="258" y="236" font-size="17" fill="#16a34a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Yes</text>
<rect x="16" y="206" width="220" height="80" rx="10" fill="#f0fdf4" stroke="#16a34a" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="126.0" y="228.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Laminar</text>
<text x="126.0" y="251.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Coriolis, PD or</text>
<text x="126.0" y="274.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">magnetic meter</text>
<line x1="400" y1="291" x2="400" y2="314" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="416" y="307" font-size="17" fill="#dc2626" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">No</text>
<polygon points="400,315.0 520.0,360 400,405.0 280.0,360" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#0284c7" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="400" y="366.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Re ≤ 4000?</text>
<line x1="520" y1="360" x2="564" y2="360" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="542" y="350" font-size="17" fill="#dc2626" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Yes</text>
<rect x="564" y="320" width="220" height="80" rx="10" fill="#fef2f2" stroke="#dc2626" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="674.0" y="342.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Transitional</text>
<text x="674.0" y="365.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">meters unreliable,</text>
<text x="674.0" y="388.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">avoid this range</text>
<line x1="400" y1="405" x2="400" y2="428" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="416" y="421" font-size="17" fill="#16a34a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">No</text>
<rect x="200" y="428" width="400" height="48" rx="10" fill="#f0f9ff" stroke="#0284c7" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="400.0" y="457.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Turbulent: check meter minimum Re</text>
<rect x="30" y="500" width="230" height="70" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#0284c7" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="145.0" y="529.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Orifice</text>
<text x="145.0" y="552.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">5,000 to 10,000+</text>
<rect x="285" y="500" width="230" height="70" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#0284c7" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="400.0" y="529.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Vortex</text>
<text x="400.0" y="552.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">10,000 to 20,000</text>
<rect x="540" y="500" width="230" height="70" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#0284c7" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="655.0" y="529.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Turbine</text>
<text x="655.0" y="552.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">5,000 to 10,000</text>

<line x1="400" y1="476" x2="400" y2="498" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
